sections.Profile:
Expressway is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Bally Manufacturing in 1971, designed by Ted Zale with artwork by Christian Marche. The game has a travel and transportation theme, featuring cars and cityscapes.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1971
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Travel, Transportation, City, Original Theme, Pollution, Traffic, Pointy People, 1970s, Cars, Single level playfield
